prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `binom_mod(n, k, p)` in src/lib.rs, returning `C(n, k) mod p` via Lucas' theorem. `p` is a prime. Return `Some(0)` when `k > n`, and `None` when `p < 2`. `n` and `k` may be as large as `10^18`, so do not compute the full factorial. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
